help_common_help_body: Tap “?” at any time to see the key tips for the current page.
help_common_language_body: Switches TilePro to German, English, Spanish, French or Chinese.
help_common_theme_body: Each tap switches to the next look: light, dark and a colorblind variant of each.
help_common_account_body: Sign in or out here, delete your account, and find the privacy policy, legal notice and support.
help_common_overflow_body: Find cloud backups, TilePro Premium, support and your account here.
help_common_cloud_backups_body: See your cloud backups here and restore projects from them.
help_welcome_sign_in_body: Sign in here. Your projects, subscription and cloud backups belong to your account.
help_projects_card_body: Tap a project card to open the project and its rooms.
help_projects_card_status_body: Set right on the card whether the project is in progress, on hold or completed.
help_projects_card_cloud_body: Backs up this project to your cloud, with a password if you like.
help_projects_card_actions_body: Edit, duplicate, share or delete the project here. To bring back deleted projects, use “{showDeleted}” in the project menu.
help_projects_menu_body: Create a new project here, and import or export projects.
help_projects_status_filter_body: Show all projects or just one status. The export in the project menu follows this filter.
help_projects_tag_filter_body: Shows only projects with the selected search tag. You assign search tags with “{edit}” on the project card.
help_deleted_projects_restore_body: Brings the project back to your active projects.
help_rooms_card_body: Tap a room card to edit the room.
help_rooms_card_selectors_body: Change the room type and status right on the card.
help_rooms_card_actions_body: Edit, duplicate, share or delete the room here. Shared rooms can be imported into other projects.
help_rooms_menu_body: Add rooms here, show deleted rooms, and import or export rooms.
help_rooms_filters_body: Filter the rooms by room type and status.
help_rooms_tag_filter_body: Shows only rooms with the selected search tag.
help_rooms_navigation_body: Switch between the project’s rooms, catalog, tile surface plan, shopping list and settings.
help_rooms_back_body: The arrow at the top left takes you back to all projects.
help_deleted_rooms_restore_body: Brings the room back into your project.
help_room_views_body: “{measure}” defines the surfaces, “{material}” covers them and “{threeD}” shows the result in 3D. “{model}” shows a scanned or imported model of the room.
help_surface_navigator_body: Use the arrows to switch between floor, walls and ceiling. Next to them, you can undo steps and bring the surface back into view with the target icon.
help_measure_start_body: Use “+” to add the floor. On mobile devices, you can also measure it with AR there.
help_measure_view_body: Drag an empty spot to move the view. Zoom with two fingers or the mouse wheel; double-tap to reset the view.
help_measure_shape_body: Drag a corner of the floor to change its shape; walls and ceiling adapt. Tap an edge to add a corner, curve the edge or move it.
help_measure_dimensions_body: Tap a length or an angle and enter the exact value.
help_measure_areas_body: Tap inside the surface, then tap a free spot to add an area such as a recess. Tap outside the surface or “Edit mode” at the edge to finish.
help_measure_toolbar_body: Set the grid size here, turn grid snapping off, or show a small 3D preview.
help_measure_side_panel_body: Open the “{handle}” tab on the right edge to set the name and room height, and to create walls and ceiling with “{walls}”.
help_material_side_panel_body: Open the “{handle}” tab on the right edge to choose colors, materials and laying patterns for the surface.
help_material_assign_body: Tap a color, material or laying pattern and the surface takes it on at once. With “{allWalls}” or “{allSurfaces}”, you cover several surfaces at once.
help_material_area_body: Tap an area in the plan to cover only that area. Without a selection, your material applies to the whole surface.
help_material_placement_body: Tap an area with a laying pattern: one finger moves the layout, two fingers rotate it, and the arrows fine-tune it step by step. Tap outside the surface to finish.
help_three_d_orbit_body: Drag to rotate the room. Zoom with two fingers or the mouse wheel; pan with two fingers or the right mouse button.
help_three_d_select_body: Tap the floor, a wall or the ceiling to select it. Then edit it in the side panel.
help_three_d_side_panel_body: Open the “{handle}” tab on the right edge to edit the selected surface, assign materials and see its laying plan.
help_three_d_toolbar_body: Start the walkthrough, open full screen and step through light and quality settings here. Press and hold an icon, or hover over it, to see its value.
help_three_d_navigator_body: “{reset}” brings the whole room back into view. Next to it, you can undo steps.
help_three_d_menu_body: Use “+” to export the room as TilePro 3D or DXF. On mobile devices, you can also place it in AR there.
help_three_d_walk_body: Press and hold a direction on the pad. On a computer, use the arrow keys or W, A, S, D; drag to look around.
help_model_orbit_body: Drag to rotate the model. Zoom with two fingers or the mouse wheel.
help_model_menu_body: Use the menu at the bottom left to import and export TilePro 3D files. On devices with LiDAR, you can also scan the room as a model there.
help_document_export_body: Use the menu at the bottom left to export this page for all rooms of the project as a PDF or Excel file.
help_tile_surfaces_selection_body: Choose the room, surface and area at the top. The plan and cut list show the whole surface; the costs refer to the selected area.
help_tile_surfaces_plan_body: Whole tiles are white; cut pieces are colored and labeled with their number from the cut list.
help_tile_surfaces_costs_body: Use “{edit}” to enter labor and additional costs for this area. They are included in the shopping list.
help_tile_surfaces_cuts_body: Each card shows a cut piece with its dimensions. Tap it to highlight the pieces in the plan.
help_shopping_summary_body: The costs and order quantities of the whole project are at the top. Boxes are rounded up to the total requirement.
help_shopping_room_status_body: Mark each room as “{open}”, “{ordered}” or “{delivered}”. Your choice is saved immediately.
help_settings_overview_body: Everything here applies to this project only. Every change is saved immediately.
help_settings_exchange_rates_body: “{refresh}” fetches current rates from the internet and saves them in the project.
help_settings_exchange_rates_handle_body: Use the tab on the right edge to open the project’s exchange rates and load current rates.
help_catalog_chain_body: A material is a surface with a texture and a real-world scale. A tile has a shape, dimensions and a price, and uses a material. A laying pattern arranges tiles into a pattern. In a room, you cover surfaces with colors, materials and laying patterns.
help_catalog_menu_body: Use the menu at the bottom left to create a material, a tile or a laying pattern – ideally in that order, since each builds on the previous one.
help_catalog_side_panel_body: Open the “{handle}” tab on the right edge to see everything this project uses, always matching the open editor.
help_catalog_entry_body: Tap a card to open it in the editor. The trash icon removes it from the catalog; it stays in your library.
help_catalog_import_body: Open your library here, with everything you have saved across projects, and add entries to this catalog.
help_editor_preview_body: Switch between “2D” and “3D”. In 3D, drag to rotate the sample.
help_editor_save_body: Once saved, the entry goes into your library and this project’s catalog. Only then is a material available in the tile editor and a tile in the laying pattern editor.
help_material_editor_basis_body: Name, category and family classify the material. The preview color shows it as long as no texture is loaded.
help_material_editor_scale_body: The edge length is the real-world size an image covers, so the texture appears at the right size. “{seamless}” suits images that tile seamlessly on all edges.
help_material_editor_texture_body: A material can’t be saved without a texture. Use “{import}” to choose a square image of 1024 × 1024 px; it is used in 2D, for previews and for the “{quality}” 3D quality.
help_material_editor_pbr_body: Optional for the “{quality}” 3D quality: choose all images of a set at once, each 1024 × 1024 px. Terms such as “normal” or “roughness” in the file names assign them.
help_material_editor_ai_body: Copies instructions for an image AI. Paste them there together with a photo of the material to generate matching texture images.
help_tile_editor_basis_body: The shape determines which dimensions you enter and which laying patterns the tile fits. The material type classifies it, for example as porcelain stoneware or natural stone.
help_tile_editor_dimensions_body: The nominal size and thickness determine the quantities and cuts. The fields depend on the shape.
help_tile_editor_price_body: Under “{priceMode}”, choose a gross price per tile or per package. A package price also needs “{perPackage}”; the shopping list uses it to work out the packages.
help_tile_editor_surface_body: Use “{material}” to give the tile a material from the catalog, so it appears with a texture. Without a material it shows the tile color, which is enough for the calculation.
help_laying_editor_basis_body: The joint width applies to the whole laying pattern and is included in the plan and quantities. You choose the joint color later when assigning it to a surface.
help_laying_editor_pattern_body: First choose the pattern family, such as grid or herringbone, then the specific pattern. That determines which tiles and rules follow.
help_laying_editor_tiles_body: Tap the tile field. Only tiles from the catalog that fit the pattern are offered; if one is missing, create it in the “{tileEditor}”.
help_laying_editor_lanes_body: Each lane gets its own tile and start offset; all tiles must have the same thickness. The picker shows for each plank whether the pattern repeats seamlessly.
help_laying_editor_grid_body: “{offset}” shifts each row against the previous one, for example by 50% for a half bond. “{diagonal}” rotates the pattern by 45° – square tiles only.
help_laying_editor_module_body: Set here how many modules you can fill individually. You swap a tile by tapping it in the 2D preview.
help_laying_editor_custom_body: Combine the formats on the grid into a module. The check below shows whether it repeats without gaps or overlaps.
help_laying_editor_wild_body: Set here when short pieces follow, where offcuts are reused and which pieces are too short.
help_laying_preview_body: In 2D you see the pattern with its joints; in 3D, drag to rotate it. For many patterns, you can swap individual tiles by tapping them in the 2D preview.
